description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the AWS Comprehend Medical service in PHP. It specifies method signatures, including synchronous and asynchronous methods for various AWS Comprehend Medical operations, and inherits from the generic AWS client.

classes.name: ComprehendMedicalClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS Comprehend Medical service, providing methods for job management, entity detection, and inference tasks.

methods.name: describeEntitiesDetectionV2Job
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific entity detection V2 job.

methods.name: describeEntitiesDetectionV2JobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a specific entity detection V2 job.

methods.name: describeICD10CMInferenceJob
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific ICD-10-CM inference job.

methods.name: describeICD10CMInferenceJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a specific ICD-10-CM inference job.

methods.name: describePHIDetectionJob
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific PHI detection job.

methods.name: describePHIDetectionJobAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a specific PHI detection job.

methods.name: detectEntities
methods.description: Detects medical entities in the supplied input text.

methods.name: detectEntitiesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously detects medical entities in the supplied input text.
